review.images: All6 exact official-gallery assets visually reviewed. Own full waterfront-building scene selected for detail/card/hero; own published living room and bedroom selected for interior scenes.
review.location: Own official page pin and regional diagram reviewed; Creek Haven and Creek Bay share the same published reference coordinates. Visible scope identifies the shared point. Own brochure physical4 time panel visually reviewed; future Blue Line qualified.
review.floorPlans: All16 complete residence title/area panels visually reviewed, TowerB physical3–18. First numerical TOTAL AREA column is sqft; second is sqm. Decimal plan codes and repeated code versions preserved with sheet numbers. Original19pagePDF and unedited full sheets retained.
